summary.plain: Japan's national accelerator laboratory at Tsukuba, founded in 1971. Its 12 GeV proton accelerator made the first long-distance beam of neutrinos ever aimed at a detector hundreds of kilometres away.
summary.technical: Inter-University Research Institute Corporation High Energy Accelerator Research Organization, Tsukuba, Ibaraki. Founded 1971 as the National Laboratory for High Energy Physics; reorganised in 1997. Host of the 12 GeV proton synchrotron (KEK-PS) that drove K2K, and co-operator of J-PARC.
